created_at_utc_note: written before any aggregate build, before any fitting, and before any reference access
purpose: one new free/coarse-to-fine chain 40Mb->10Mb->5Mb->2Mb->1Mb->500kb->200kb; the 200kb physical endpoint is then coarsened to the original 1Mb bins by arithmetic mean and compared with the two existing versions on the frozen old21 evaluation support

cohort_identity.observation_unit: chromosome (20 correlated measurements of one cell; the 40 copy tracks are not independent replicates)
cohort_identity.raw_records_note: all 1703888 records are used; no shrink, no downsample, no reference mask applied to training beads

objective.p_prior_weight_note: the p_prior term is already multiplied by 1e-4 inside the frozen implementation (P_PRIOR_STRENGTH); the weight itself stays 1.0
objective.l0: (2*n_loci)^(-1/3) per layer, r0 = 2*l0 read from the layer data
objective.grid_policy: all 20 chromosomes keep their complete header grid at every layer; no reference-mask bead removal; no per-copy support objective (the 051 C branch is not used)

optimizer.endpoint: last callback-confirmed finite accepted state; unaccepted line-search trial discarded

initialization.root: 014 unlabeled random blind source (seed 2207), expanded to the 40Mb full grid with the frozen 0.025*l0 perturbation and radial clip
initialization.prolongation_rule: each later layer is initialized from this chain's own previous-layer endpoint via reconstruction_init.warm_start_from_layer (interpolate + 0.025*l0 noise on new_or_repeated loci + radial clip)
initialization.forbidden: no reset to a baseline 5Mb/1Mb start anywhere in this chain

budget_honesty: every layer is deliberately budget-limited for speed; expect and report status=budget_not_converged. No convergence claim is made.

input_policy.40_10_5_2_1Mb: reuse the frozen aggregates (045 1Mb aggregate and 051 real_<bin>_aggregate.npz) after SHA verification and after an exact fold-consistency check against the frozen 1Mb aggregate
input_policy.500kb_200kb: must be re-aggregated from the raw 7-column unlabeled pair file at exact bp resolution; coarse 1Mb/500kb counts may never be split into fine bins
input_policy.conservation: every layer must keep raw_records = 1703888 and its diag/cis-offdiag/inter split must fold back exactly to the frozen 1Mb aggregate

coarsening.input: chain endpoint 200kb physical coordinates (sphere-mapped unit-ball xyz)
coarsening.output: coarsened 1Mb candidate on the original 1Mb bin grid
coarsening.rule: per chromosome, per copy, arithmetic mean of the 200kb sub-bin coordinates with bin key floor(original_bp / 1000000); every complete 1Mb bin averages 5 sub-bins, a partial terminal bin averages the actual 1..5 sub-bins present
coarsening.forbidden: no every-5th-bead picking, no distance-matrix averaging, no re-optimization, no re-centering, no rescaling
coarsening.reporting: per-bin contributing bead count and total conservation in a small json only

evaluation.reference_use: read only after the 200kb endpoint and the coarsened 1Mb candidate are written and hashed; never used for initialization, training, stopping or selection
evaluation.positions_rule: positions + pair_i/pair_j/common are taken verbatim from the frozen snapshot (positions = arange(3000000, chromosome_length, 1000000))
evaluation.candidate_index_rule: global_index = offset(chromosome) + bp // 1000000 with offset = cumsum of ceil(chromosome_length/1000000)
evaluation.support: fixed 2447 valid loci, 157529 intra pairs, 20 chromosomes, identical for all three versions; a bug may never silently shrink it
evaluation.metric: signed Spearman rho on euclidean distances of the coarsened coordinates; average-tie ranks
evaluation.copy_mapping: per chromosome the best of {direct: A->mat,B->pat ; swapped: A->pat,B->mat} is chosen once by the Spearman same/cross mean; same = mean of the two matched rho, cross = mean of the two crossed rho
evaluation.denominator: 20 same and 20 cross values per version; the 40 copy tracks are not independent replicates; NA is preserved and never nanmean-ed into a fake n=20
evaluation.scope: single cell only; no bootstrap, no significance test, no new null, no R1/R3

budget_limitation: the three versions do not share an equal FG budget (1502 vs 1902 vs 2202); this is a coarse-to-fine chain comparison with unequal, deliberately cheap coarse layers, not an equal-cost comparison
